OSKAR HADDAD-LINDQVIST
Full-Stack Developer | TypeScript, React, Node.js

Email: oskar.hl@example.com | Phone: +46 70 555 0808
GitHub: oskarhl-example | Blog: oskar-codes.example.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Full-stack developer with 10+ years of professional web development experience, including extensive work with React, TypeScript, Node.js and SQL databases. Builds and improves web applications end to end, from accessible, responsive interfaces to backend services and production deployments. Experienced with automated testing, performance improvements, third-party integrations and collaborating with designers and cross-functional teams.

CORE SKILLS
Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js, HTML, CSS, SCSS, Angular, AngularJS, React Native, Vue, Storybook, Redux, React Query
Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express, REST APIs, GraphQL, PHP, Laravel
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase, Prisma, TypeORM
Testing and delivery: Jest, Playwright, Cypress, React Testing Library, Supertest, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker
Cloud and tools: AWS (ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, CloudWatch, RDS), Linux, Nginx, Varnish, Terraform (maintaining existing files), Figma, Jira, Confluence, Sentry, Datadog, Unleash
Accessibility and product: WCAG 2.1 AA audit fixes, responsive web experiences, A/B testing, feature flags, Agile/Scrum, BankID

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Full-Stack Developer | Älvgrind Fintech AB | Gothenburg
2021–Present
- Develop customer onboarding features in a six-person team, working across React and TypeScript frontend applications and Node.js backend services built with NestJS and Express.
- Built a new identity verification flow integrating the BankID API, including QR-code handling, error states and retries. A/B testing and rollout improved onboarding conversion from 61% to 74%.
- Developed a document-upload workflow using S3 presigned URLs, ClamAV scanning in Lambda, and SQS and PostgreSQL status tracking.
- Helped migrate legacy Express services to NestJS and maintain a GraphQL backend-for-frontend with another developer.
- Improved mobile Largest Contentful Paint from 4.1 seconds to 1.9 seconds through code splitting, image optimisation, removing Moment.js and replacing a large charting library. Also introduced server-side rendering with Next.js for landing pages.
- Fixed accessibility issues in the onboarding flow against WCAG 2.1 AA and migrated the frontend from Create React App to Vite in 2023.
- Use Jest and Playwright for automated testing; work with GitHub Actions, Docker, AWS and feature flags (Unleash).
- Collaborate with designers in Figma, participate in the on-call rotation, and interview engineering candidates. The onboarding team received the 2023 internal Customer Impact Award.

Developer | Sjöbris Digital Agency AB | Gothenburg
2018–2021
- Built websites and web applications for approximately 25 clients across retail, local government, transport and sports.
- Delivered client applications using Angular, React and Vue, with backend services in Node.js/Express and PHP/Laravel.
- Co-developed a React Native ticket-purchasing app for a ferry company; the app reached approximately 50,000 downloads. Served as project tech lead.
- Built and maintained WordPress sites, including custom themes and plugins, and established GitLab CI for the agency.
- Worked with MySQL, MongoDB and Firebase across client projects.

Web Developer | Nordkust Media AB | Gothenburg
2014–2018
- Developed newspaper websites and an article editor using PHP, jQuery and AngularJS.
- Implemented a paywall integration and configured Varnish caching.
- Performed Linux server administration in Ubuntu environments and worked with MySQL.

Freelance / Student Web Developer
2012–2014
- Built websites for friends, family, a local bakery and two bands using PHP, jQuery and WordPress.

EDUCATION
Bachelor in Computer Science | West Coast University College (Högskola), Gothenburg | 2011–2014
Graduated 2014

Additional learning: Advanced React Patterns (2022); AWS Cloud Practitioner course (2020, exam not taken); Coursera Machine Learning (2017, not completed).

ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE AND ACTIVITIES
- Coding bootcamp mentor in Gothenburg, 2019–2020 (evenings).
- Speaker at a local JavaScript meetup in 2022: “Migrating Express to NestJS without Stopping the World”.
- Driving licence: B.

LANGUAGES
Swedish: Native | English: Fluent (work language) | Arabic: Spoken at home; limited writing | German: School-level; limited current proficiency

REFERENCES
Available on request.

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, well-structured CV with clear reverse-chronological experience, relevant technical skills, measurable achievements, and credible detail. The strongest evidence includes the onboarding conversion improvement from 61% to 74%, mobile LCP improvement from 4.1 seconds to 1.9 seconds, the 50,000-download React Native app, BankID integration, AWS delivery, and automated testing. The document is professional and substantially more focused than the original candidate information. The main remaining opportunity is to foreground a few role-specific concepts more explicitly, particularly unit/end-to-end testing terminology and the security relevance of the BankID and document-upload work.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: ATS compatibility is very good. The CV uses standard section headings, conventional reverse-chronological formatting, searchable technology names, and readable bullet points. It contains strong matches for React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, Express, PostgreSQL, Jest, Playwright, GitHub Actions, AWS, Docker, Next.js, Storybook, WCAG, and A/B testing. AI screening probability is high because the role title and summary are closely aligned and the experience bullets provide concrete evidence rather than only listing keywords. Minor improvements would be to use the exact phrases "unit testing," "end-to-end testing," and "Git-based workflows" where accurate, and to format GitHub and blog details as complete URLs if they are intended to be clickable.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The CV is a strong match for the core full-stack requirements. It clearly demonstrates more than 2 years of professional React and TypeScript experience; Node.js services with NestJS and Express; SQL database work with PostgreSQL and MySQL; responsive and accessible web development; automated testing; GitHub Actions and GitLab CI; AWS and Docker; Next.js/server-side rendering; Storybook; and A/B testing. The fintech KYC/onboarding experience is relevant transferable experience from a regulated environment, although the CV does not claim healthcare experience. The BankID identity-verification integration and ClamAV document scanning provide relevant security-adjacent evidence. However, the document does not establish explicit OWASP Top 10 awareness or specific health-data privacy experience/willingness, so these remain candidate-material gaps rather than CV-writing defects. English is clearly shown as fluent and the work language. German is listed but described as school-level and limited, so it is not a strong customer-facing language match.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR ENHANCEMENTS:
1. In the Professional Summary section, revise the final sentence to foreground the job's testing and delivery language while remaining truthful: change "Experienced with automated testing, performance improvements, third-party integrations and collaborating with designers and cross-functional teams." to "Experienced with unit and end-to-end testing, performance improvements, third-party integrations and collaborating with designers and cross-functional teams." This is supported by the candidate's Jest and Playwright experience.
2. In the Core Skills section, change the heading "Testing and delivery" to "Testing and Git-based delivery" and retain the existing tools: Jest, Playwright, Cypress, React Testing Library, Supertest, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI and Docker. This makes the existing Git-based workflow evidence more explicit without adding an unsupported skill.
3. In the Älvgrind Fintech AB experience section, revise the document-upload bullet to make its security relevance clearer without claiming OWASP expertise: change "Developed a document-upload workflow using S3 presigned URLs, ClamAV scanning in Lambda, and SQS and PostgreSQL status tracking." to "Developed a document-upload workflow using S3 presigned URLs, ClamAV malware scanning in Lambda, and SQS and PostgreSQL status tracking." The candidate information explicitly supports ClamAV virus scanning.
4. In the contact line, convert "GitHub: oskarhl-example | Blog: oskar-codes.example.com" into complete, clickable URLs if these are actual public links, for example "GitHub: https://github.com/... | Blog: https://...". Do not add or invent URLs that are not available.
critique.critical_issues:
Claims the sources (the candidate's own material; for the employer, the job ad and company research) do not support:
- “responsive interfaces” / “responsive web experiences” — the candidate’s material mentions mobile performance but does not explicitly support experience building responsive interfaces or layouts.
unsupported_claims: “responsive interfaces” / “responsive web experiences” — the candidate’s material mentions mobile performance but does not explicitly support experience building responsive interfaces or layouts.

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, well-structured CV with a clear target profile, relevant technical breadth, and credible quantified achievements. The Professional Summary is concise and the experience section demonstrates meaningful impact through metrics such as onboarding conversion improving from 61% to 74%, mobile LCP improving from 4.1 seconds to 1.9 seconds, and approximately 50,000 app downloads. The CV is professional and appropriately emphasizes recent React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS, testing, accessibility, and collaboration experience. Minor opportunities remain to make a few job-relevant capabilities more explicit, particularly responsive layouts, security fundamentals, and the type of testing performed.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The document uses conventional section headings, chronological experience, plain text formatting, and keyword-rich skills sections, making it highly parseable by ATS platforms. It contains strong matches for React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, Express, PostgreSQL, Jest, Playwright, GitHub Actions, AWS, Docker, Next.js, Storybook, and A/B testing. AI screening probability is high for the core technical requirements. The main ATS limitation is that some relevant concepts are implied rather than stated using the job description's wording: responsive layouts, semantic HTML, web security fundamentals, authentication, and privacy/data protection. Do not add unsupported OWASP or healthcare privacy claims, but make the supported security and accessibility evidence more explicit.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: Alignment is excellent for the core role. The CV clearly demonstrates substantially more than the required two years of React and TypeScript experience, Node.js backend development, SQL databases, automated unit and end-to-end testing, Git-based workflows, AWS, Docker, Next.js, Storybook, accessibility work, and A/B testing. BankID identity verification, KYC onboarding, document upload, malware scanning, and fintech experience provide relevant evidence of authentication, sensitive-data handling, and work in a regulated-adjacent environment. Fluent English is explicitly shown. The candidate does not show healthcare or patient-data experience, explicit OWASP Top 10 knowledge, or willingness to learn health-data privacy requirements; these are alignment gaps rather than CV writing defects. German is listed only at school level with limited current proficiency, and no Croatian is shown.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR, HIGH-VALUE ENHANCEMENTS:
1. In the Professional Summary, change the phrase "from accessible interfaces to backend services and production deployments" to "from responsive, accessible web interfaces using HTML/CSS to Node.js backend services and production deployments". This uses terminology from the job description while staying supported by the candidate's HTML/CSS experience, mobile performance work, and accessibility fixes.
2. In the Core Skills section under "Accessibility and product," change "WCAG 2.1 AA audit fixes" to "Web accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA audit fixes, accessible interfaces, responsive mobile performance". This makes the accessibility and low-end/mobile performance alignment easier for ATS and recruiters to identify without claiming WCAG 2.2 AA experience.
3. In the Älvgrind Fintech AB experience section, revise the BankID bullet to begin "Implemented an identity-verification and authentication flow using the BankID API...". The existing evidence supports identity verification and BankID integration, and this wording better connects the achievement to the job's security requirement.
4. In the same Älvgrind experience section, revise the document-upload bullet to explicitly retain the security detail: "Developed a secure document-upload workflow using S3 presigned URLs, ClamAV malware scanning in Lambda, and SQS/PostgreSQL status tracking." This improves keyword relevance for security fundamentals while remaining faithful to the original candidate information.
5. In the testing bullet under Älvgrind, change "Use Jest and Playwright for automated testing" to "Write Jest unit tests and Playwright end-to-end tests, and maintain Git-based delivery through GitHub Actions, Docker and AWS." Only use "unit tests" if that accurately reflects the candidate's Jest work; the original information confirms Jest and Playwright but does not specify the exact test categories. If the categories are not confirmed, use "Write automated tests with Jest and Playwright and maintain Git-based delivery through GitHub Actions, Docker and AWS."
